instruction.name: vsrar.b
instruction.description: Variable arithmetic right shift of b elements.

latencies.notes: vj -> vd; consecutive unrolled copies form a chain. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsrar.b $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vsrar.b $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vsrar.b $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vsrar.b $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vsrar.b $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vsrar.b $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vsrar.b $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vsrar.b $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr1, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4' --asm 'vsrar.b $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vsrar.b $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vsrar.b $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vsrar.b $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vsrar.b $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vsrar.b $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vsrar.b $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vsrar.b $vr7, $vr15, $vr23'
